t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Nidi kanbaji keyi O Nzambi yami, netu yeyi wanleñeli mulona wakukwiluka ni kuku hameka. Nashimuni chalala lelu dinu kuzeya kwami ni ñovu jeyi, uzweñi wami ni kůheta kweyi. Kosi Nzambi mukwau china yeyi hohu, ona wakulaña mu malwa, ona wahaya nyaka kudi eyi aweni.
